faq.q: What products does Magic House offer?
faq.a: Magic House makes handmade gypsum pieces: candles and candle holders, incense burners and boxes, incense and candle sets, trays and coasters, religious gifts and decor, wedding and Mother's Day gifts, and decorative gift sets.
Yes. Every piece is cast and finished by hand in Lebanon, so small variations between pieces are part of their character.
Yes. Many pieces can be made in custom colors, and gift sets can be put together for occasions. Send your idea on WhatsApp and we will tell you what is possible.

faq.q: How can I order from Magic House?
faq.a: Tap Order via WhatsApp on any product. A message with the product name and link opens in WhatsApp, and we confirm availability, price, and delivery with you there.

faq.q: Does Magic House offer products for special occasions?
faq.a: Yes. Magic House pieces are made for weddings, baptisms, baby showers, Mother's Day, holidays, and corporate souvenirs, as well as everyday decor.
